summary: This Phase 4 clinical trial tested adding a drug called empagliflozin to the treatment plans of adults with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus who also have obesity. Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus is a condition where the body does not use insulin properly to control blood sugar. The study included 150 participants and was sponsored by SINA Health Education and Welfare Trust. This trial has been completed.
